request_contract.parameter_rules: One explicit opted-in anonymous GET of https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/25988293/versions/1 only, no redirect, caller ID/URL/version/host/path/query/headers, pagination, follow-up download or retry. response_contract.format: Figshare original public version-1 article metadata JSON: original release file identity contains two alternate GIS archives (GDW_v1_0_gdb.zip and GDW_v1_0_shp.zip) AND a separately published final technical document (GDW_TechDoc_v1_0.pdf). These are 3 archival files, not 3 independent scientific datasets.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Figshare v1 metadata identifies the Global Dam Watch dataset, two alternative GIS archive formats and a separately published final 15-page TechDoc. Original v1 manual identifies 41,145 WGS84 barrier points, 35,295 associated reservoir polygons linked by GDW_ID; 5,850 point-only barrier records legitimately lack a polygon. Original numeric missing values use -99 and missing elevations -9999; blank text is unknown. These are source-defined conventions for a separately reviewed future import, not measured zero, independently verified source archive bytes, dam-failure probabilities, hydraulic inundation, site-specific insured exposure or model readiness.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Figshare official API documentation recommends at most one request per second and reserves throttle/block rights. This contract permits one explicitly invoked fixed metadata GET without pagination, redirects, retry, file retrieval or a scheduled acquisition loop.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Original version-specific Figshare v1 public article JSON retrieved 2026-11-04 and reported article total 127,938,795 bytes comprising final PDF (716,288 bytes, file 47913739), Geodatabase ZIP (57,476,758 bytes, 47913742) and Shapefile ZIP (69,745,749 bytes, 47913754). Provider-supplied and computed MD5 fields agreed for each file; these are metadata declarations, not independently recalculated byte receipts. Any version or metadata drift must fail closed. Original ZIP/GIS file acquisition requires distinct review, exact SHA-256, attribute/geometry quality gates and full final v1 TechDoc rights check.

rights_and_policy.notes: Final publisher v1.0 TechDoc (July 2024, Figshare file 47913739, section 4.1) and original Figshare v1 item both explicitly state CC BY 4.0. The final technical document also asks users to refrain from full original-format mirror/rehosting on third-party websites without authors' written permission. This is an author request, not proof of a different legal licence; project publication policy remains metadata-only with no original provider files in Git. Figshare's public Data Access Policy and API guidance support bounded anonymous metadata access and responsible rate usage. A live source-specific parser receipt, exact original archive bytes, derivative/publication decision and model rights remain separate stages.
